html:
The last stretch of the road asks what any of this is still for: where these classical ideas resurface, unannounced, inside modern deep learning; when to actually reach for one today; and a capstone that walks the whole planet in one place.

Topics on this stretch of the road:

  • Modern Hopfield Networks and Attention: a 2020 result showing a generalised Hopfield network update is, mathematically, attention.
  • Choosing Classical vs Modern Approaches: when associative memory, spiking hardware, or a fixed reservoir actually beats a standard deep net.
  • Capstone: Where Classical Neural Computing Meets Modern Deep Learning: one small project, drawing on both planets.
